name: aurora-os
description: Aurora — a complete operating system in the browser. Window manager, virtual file system, terminal with 35+ commands, 8 applications, themes, wallpapers and procedural audio. TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.build:test: esbuild src/core/EventBus.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/EventBus.js && esbuild src/fs/FileSystem.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/FileSystem.js && esbuild src/term/commands.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/commands.js && esbuild src/core/AuroraState.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/AuroraState.js
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node tests/run-tests.mjs && node tests/aurora-state.test.mjs
